summary: Help managers question analytics and AI outputs, design simple experiments, and improve team decisions. Explore the course and build practical capability.
lede: Data literacy and AI fluency help managers assess analytics and AI outputs before using them to guide team decisions. Designed for supervisors, functional managers and business professionals, the course addresses how to question evidence and make responsible decisions without building models or writing code. Participants practise interpreting KPIs, checking data quality and uncertainty, reviewing AI outputs, planning simple experiments and documenting decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for managers who use analytics or AI outputs to guide team priorities, review performance, or explain decisions, without needing to build models or write code.
audience: Customer Experience Managers using feedback analytics
modules: Manager Data Literacy and Decision Quality
NIST AI RMF for Manager Decisions
Data Habits in Team Performance Routines
Manager Data and AI Action Plan
prerequisites: You should be comfortable reading routine business reports and discussing team performance measures. No coding or statistical software experience is required.
